title: Mask 2D-3D: Adaptive Dual-Masked Autoencoder Network for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
abstract: arXiv:2609.18088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detection-free methods for image-to-point cloud registration are prone to erroneous correspondences caused by domain and modality discrepancies, limited sensitivity of feature extractors, and the presence of non-overlapping regions. The Masked Autoencoder (MAE) has shown strong performance in visual representation for images and point clouds. It may be helpful to apply this approach to image-to-point cloud registration, a task that requires unified feature extraction and accurate cross-modal correspondences. Standard MAE's random masking may overlook key regions due to limited camera views, reducing registration effectiveness. To address this, we propose the Intermodal Dual-MAE Framework (ID-MAE) with a Similarity-based RL Masking Strategy (SRLM), which adaptively masks informative positions by leveraging cross-modal similarity and reinforcement learning, thus narrowing the modality gap. translated_title: Mask 2D-3D：用于图像到点云配准的自适应双重掩码自编码器网络
translated_abstract: 无检测的图像到点云配准方法容易因域与模态差异、特征提取器灵敏度有限以及非重叠区域的存在而产生错误对应关系。掩码自编码器（MAE）在图像和点云的视觉表示方面已展现出强大性能，将该方法应用于图像到点云配准这一需要统一特征提取和精确跨模态对应关系的任务可能有所帮助。然而，标准MAE的随机掩码策略可能因相机视角有限而忽略关键区域，降低配准效果。为解决这一问题，我们提出了跨模态双重MAE框架（ID-MAE），并结合基于相似度的强化学习掩码策略（SRLM），通过利用跨模态相似性和强化学习自适应地掩码信息丰富的位置，从而缩小模态差距。我们的方法增强了跨模态表示学习……
tldr: 提出ID-MAE框架，结合基于相似度的强化学习掩码策略（SRLM），自适应地掩码关键区域以缩小图像与点云间的模态差距，从而提升图像到点云配准的准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes the ID-MAE framework with a similarity-based reinforcement learning masking strategy (SRLM) that adaptively masks informative regions to narrow the modality gap, improving image-to-point cloud registration accuracy.
